notes.title: N-GON 1.18 update adds FPS settings and a little more
notes.content:
The game is no longer locked* to 60 FPS, you can customize target FPS in screen settings. 
* Game still locks framerate if it goes below 40. This is to prevent physics engine from going bonkers

During the first game launch after this update the game should set target FPS to your monitor's refresh rate. If that doesn't happen, or you want to change it manually go to [b]Settings -> Screen[/b] and set target FPS you want. I'd say that matching your monitor's refresh rate works and looks best, but I'm not your dad :)

This update also includes some visual and audio changes: little animation tweaks, visuals tweaks and replacement of some sound effects.

I hope you like the new update, if you encounter any issues, please contact me on the forums. Cheers!

notes.title: 1.11 update + soundtrack release!
A major update
Bug fixes, landscape mode, enemy animations, other minor improvements
notes.content:
After a bit of a rough start, N-GON is finally live and works as intended.
I'm sorry for everyone who had to experience the terrible bug upon running the game for the first time.

If you stumble upon any other problems - please let me know on the forums!
Thank you for your patience, I hope you'll enjoy the game!
